test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
For a ray of light undergoing refraction through a triangular glass prism, which of the following statements is/are always correct?

(a) Angle of incidence is the angle between the incident ray and normal at the point of incidence.

(b) Angle of incidence is equal to angle of emergence.

(c) Angle of deviation is the angle between incident ray and emergent ray.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (a) and (c).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **angle of incidence** is the angle between the** incident ray** and the** normal** at the point of incidence.

 
 
• This statement is always **correct.**
 
 
 
• The **angle of emergence** is the angle between the** emergent ray** and the **normal** at the point of emergence.
 
 
• It is **not always equal** to the angle of incidence.
 
 
 
• The **angle of deviation** is the angle between the **incident ray** and the **emergent ray.**
 
 
• **​**This statement is also **correct**.
 
 
 
• When a ray of light passes through a** triangular glass prism**, it undergoes **refraction twice, **once at the entry face and once at the exit face.
 
• The **deviation of the ray** depends on the** angle of incidence** and the refractive index of the prism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **prism** is a **solid, transparent, uniform refracting medium** that is enclosed by** two angled plane** surfaces.
 
• The widely used prism features** three rectangular surfaces i**n addition to two parallel triangle faces.
 
• A standard triangular prism can **divide white light **into its component colors, or what is known as a** spectrum.**
 
• Because light travels at** different rates **inside of glass, a prism functions.
